title: riedlea chamaedrys
intro: Riedlea chamaedrys, commonly known as Wild Chamomile, is a perennial herb native to the southeastern regions of Australia. It is valued for its health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues and promoting relaxation, due to its anti-inflammatory and anti-spasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Riedlea chamaedrys include calming anxiety, reducing stress and promoting a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, particularly apigenin and luteolin, which contribute to its medicinal value.
